observed_title: 從 2013 到 2023: Web Security 十年之進化與趨勢!

retrieval.quote_verification: agent_browser --session orange-O007 eval: each quotation passed an exact String.includes check against its original article paragraph textContent, without whitespace normalization. The preceding heading and paragraph position were checked; all five matches were true and lengths were 31–65 characters. Title and final URL were observed in the same DOM.

reason: The actual article contains five substantive web-security trend reflections accompanying a developer talk, so it is not merely a slides link or announcement. It supplies useful architecture, implementation, interpretation and execution-context review lenses, but not a primary investigation with probe selection, failures or validation. Retain these as context rather than promote them into operational additions or handoff contracts.

evidence.locator: 1. 架構層面的攻擊逐漸成為顯學 — opening paragraph (article paragraph 7)
evidence.quote: 原有的網頁應用、網頁伺服器如何去跟這些新角色進行搭配，這些組合的互動如何引入新的攻擊面

evidence.locator: 2. 對底層邏輯重新梳理的攻擊 — opening paragraph (article paragraph 8)
evidence.quote: 為了因應這個趨勢，攻擊者不得不開始往框架、甚至程式語言底層挖掘

evidence.locator: 3. 不一致性所造成的攻擊面 — opening paragraph, final sentence (article paragraph 11)
evidence.quote: 隨著處理資料的來源越多、各家來源對同一筆資料又存在著不同的解釋，解釋間的不一致就可能造成安全上的問題。

evidence.locator: 4. 跨應用組合所導致的新攻擊 — opening paragraph (article paragraph 13)
evidence.quote: 無論是跨協議的組合、跨規範的誤用、跨領域的結合，甚至把不同的 Convention 組合在一起

evidence.locator: 5. 當前端安全不只在前端… — third paragraph, discussing server-side rendering and automation (article paragraph 16)
evidence.quote: 以往許多需要使用者互動的 XSS 現在都可以直接在伺服器端(或自動地)觸發，這些都是讓網頁前端安全與後端安全的邊界愈加模糊的一點。

workflow.decision: Contextual review lens, not a demonstrated investigation: consider interactions between components, protocols and conventions rather than assessing each component in isolation.
Contextual review lens: when application-level protections move the remaining risk into implementation details, consider framework and language-runtime behavior as additional review scope.
Contextual review lens: compare the meanings different consumers assign to the same data across its processing lifetime; disagreement suggests a security question, not proof of a violation.
Contextual review lens: identify the actual execution environment and automation before assuming web-content processing needs user interaction or remains a frontend-only concern.

limitations: This is an explicitly conceptual, developer-oriented overview of historical trends, presented as the author's personal view. It does not document a reproducible investigation, negative controls, failed probes or independently verified findings.
Named frameworks, runtimes and browser technologies are examples or deployment components, not reported research-tool usage. No tool attribution is inferred from their mention.
The introduction explicitly leaves defensive methods outside the talk's scope; no remediation technique or regression gate is established here.
Examples and impact claims remain source-author reports. Their underlying articles, slides and attachments were not opened, and no source code or targets were executed or tested.

Historical statements do not establish current reachability, parser behavior, runtime configuration or confinement. The contextual review lenses are not an observed step-by-step method and do not support a new handoff contract.
excluded_material: Slide downloads and linked exploit walkthroughs or code
Payloads, endpoint strings, exploit sequences and target-specific constants
Product-specific vulnerability answers and exploit-chain details
Promotional framing, personal asides and unverified impact escalation
Unsupported research-tool attribution, invented validation and invented skill handoffs
